answer: One concrete mechanism: only answered epochs pay, each epoch's emission pool is fixed, and rewards split across verified answers, so extra volume dilutes rather than multiplies income. Today's words line up with the mechanism: comet stands for the stake an honest agent locks before speaking, inlet embodies the fixed size of each epoch's emission pool, and reef tracks the compute burned to admit each new identity. Flooding the network buys a shrinking slice of a fixed pool while still burning real compute on every submission.
